records.name: Cloudflare OS

records.name: hey postcard - digital postcards

records.name: Website to Markdown API

records.name: Aveiro

records.name: DevTools by Hakeemify

Features a self-serve 60-second diagnostic engine and a 14-day free pilot program. Recover your cash runway today at obsidian-treasury.netlify.app.

records.name: Keipr

records.name: Aridelle

Adjust colors, strokes, sizes, and styles, then export clean SVGs, PNGs, or developer-ready code. Miss a bug and it "ships" — incidents, 3am pages, and postmortems land on your dashboard. 244 exercises across Python, React/TS, Go, SQL, and LLM agents. Select and copy only the text you need directly from a screenshot with offline OCR, annotate or redact images, and record, trim, and annotate video. Native to Windows. Everything stays local. Free 14-day trial, then one $19 purchase. No subscription.

records.name: NEBU
records.tagline: Nebu is an interactive safe AI companion toy that talks REAL
records.description: Nebu talks, teaches, and plays with children ages 4 to 12. An educational stuffed animal with AI, parental controls, and screen-free voice-activated adventures.

records.name: Sumber Ai
records.tagline: Gamified AI platform for English learning & local business
records.description: Sumber AI (sumberai.id) adalah platform AI gamifikasi untuk pembelajaran bahasa Inggris interaktif dan pemberdayaan UMKM Indonesia. Belajar, bermain, kumpulkan SmartCoin, belanja di UMKM lokal.

records.name: Ordelio.io
records.tagline: App-free browser queues for pickup and service counters
records.description: Ordelio is browser-based queue management for pickup counters and customer-facing teams. Staff create order or ticket numbers, update their status, and run a public display from a web workspace. Customers follow the queue on a shared screen or open their status page from a QR code or link—without installing an app. The core workflow needs no dedicated queue hardware or mandatory POS integration. Start with one simple queue, then add users, devices, customization, and analytics on eligible plans.

records.name: Pietralite
records.tagline: Why Architects and Designers Prefer Natural Stone Veneer
records.description: Pietralite is a leading Slate Stone Veneer Manufacturer & Supplier in India. Explore premium natural slate stone veneer sheets for interior walls, exterior cladding, ceilings, furniture and architectural applications.

records.name: HollowByte
records.tagline: Application Security for Founders & SMBs
records.description: AI app security audits for founders. HollowByte finds exposed keys, broken auth, Supabase RLS issues, unsafe payment flows, and gives clear fixes fast.

records.name: CaseHero
records.tagline: Your own record of every call with a company
records.description: Ever been told "we never said that"? CaseHero gives you your own copy of every call with a company. It transcribes the conversation, pulls out the key facts and promises they made, and rolls every call about one issue into a single running record. So the next time they deny it, you have their exact words.

records.name: Marsad
records.tagline: Errors, traces and cookieless analytics in one SDK
records.description: Error tracking and cookieless analytics from one SDK, for Next.js and Expo. Grouped issues with source-mapped stacks, traces you can read, traffic and Web Vitals per page. No consent banner. Free plan, no credit card. Paid from $9/mo, flat per org.

records.name: MapZot.AI
records.tagline: What If You Could See Every Location's Potential?| MapZot.AI
records.description: MapZot.AI's location intelligence platform reveals foot traffic, demographics, and whitespace opportunities — so your next site decision is data-backed, not gut-driven.

records.name: Finance OS
records.tagline: Simple personal finance, online or offline
records.description: Finance OS is a simple personal finance app for managing accounts, expenses, cards, goals and recurring payments. It works online and offline, syncs changes when the connection returns, and keeps each user's financial information private.

records.name: Conversion Tools
records.tagline: What to use when visitors won't convert
records.description: A curated directory of conversion tools for PMs, growth leads, and solo builders. Organised by the job — analytics, experiments, onboarding, pricing — for when people visit but don't sign up, try, or pay.

records.name: Air Winch
records.tagline: Air Winch | Air Winch For Sale
records.description: As a lightweight lifting machine, the air winch has a wide range of applications in various fields. Welcome to contact us for more details!

records.name: Love Link
records.tagline: Write a love letter. Send it as a private link.
records.description: Create a private love letter link with an animated envelope, typewriter reveal, and QR code. Preview free, then share online in minutes.

records.name: Galifix
records.tagline: Encuentra a los mejores profesionales locales fácilmente
records.description: Conecta con profesionales locales de confianza, sin intermediarios ni comisiones abusivas. ¿Necesitas un electricista, un fontanero o ayuda técnica cerca de ti? En Galifix ponemos en contacto directo a clientes y profesionales independientes de tu zona. Rápido, claro y justo para todos.

records.name: Image Inverter
records.tagline: Image Inverter - Invert Image Colors Online
records.description: Image Inverter flips every color in your photo online. Upload, paste, preview, and download a negative image as PNG, JPG, BMP, or WebP.

records.name: Orbfile
records.tagline: a file converter that keeps your files on your computer
records.description: Most online converters upload your files to a server. I wanted the opposite. OrbFile processes files directly inside the browser whenever possible, keeping documents, images, audio, and video on the user's machine. It currently includes more than 200 tools covering conversion, compression, resizing, and common document utilities. The project has been an interesting challenge in balancing privacy, performance, and browser limitations.

records.name: AediFlow
records.tagline: AI platform for Property Management
records.description: AI assistant for property managers. Tenant messages answered, late rent chased, indexation applied, invoices reconciled, vendors booked — automatically, with your one-click OK where you want it.

records.name: Subreaper
records.tagline: Kill zombie subscriptions. Own it forever.
records.description: Subreaper tracks SaaS, cloud, and AI subscriptions across multiple currencies, then helps you kill the ones you forgot about. - Terminal-inspired, dark mode only - One-swipe "Kill" with a running "Total Reaped" savings counter - Multi-currency support (amounts stored in original currency, converted for display) - $2.99 once. No ads. No subscription to manage your subscriptions. Built for freelancers and engineers drowning in zombie SaaS costs. Free tier covers up to 5 subscriptions.

records.name: SafeMailer.io
records.tagline: Secure Email Encryption Software
records.description: Secure email encryption built for modern business. Protect sensitive emails and files with strong encryption, seamless Gmail and Outlook integration, recipient-friendly access, and compliance-ready workflows for healthcare, finance, education, government, and other regulated industries.

records.name: PWS Environmental
records.tagline: Environmentally Sustainable Solutions to Geotechnical
records.description: PWS Environmental delivers practical, compliant, and nationwide environmental solutions for businesses that need expert support. From site investigations and remediation to soil stabilization, hydrogeology, invasive species management, and specialist construction services, their team helps protect land, water, and compliance with confidence, quality, and care for sustainable results across the UK.

records.name: AsliCV
records.tagline: Build your CV, cover letter, and motivation letter online
records.description: Build your CV, cover letter, and motivation letter online. Pick a template, edit with live preview, and download PDF. Free. No watermark.

records.name: SEO Arena
records.tagline: Weekly SEO & Hosting Quiz with Global Leaderboard
records.description: SEO Arena is a free weekly challenge that helps you learn Technical SEO, website performance, and web hosting through fast-paced quizzes. Compete on a global leaderboard, earn certificates, and build real-world skills in minutes.

records.name: Squid League
records.tagline: Squid League is the football survival game.
records.description: Squid League es el juego de supervivencia de fútbol. Elige un equipo cada jornada. Si pierde o empata, quedas eliminado. El último jugador en pie gana el bote.

records.name: Chipin Corp
records.tagline: CCTV Camera Installation Company in Dubai
records.description: Advanced CCTV security solutions in Dubai offering HD monitoring, remote access, and smart surveillance for homes, offices, and businesses.

records.name: Creator Kit Hub
records.tagline: PDF Tool, Image Converter, Lorem Context Builder
records.description: Creator Kit Hub offers a comprehensive, completely free, and 100% offline suite of client-side web tools. Securely process PDFs, convert high-resolution images, generate precise social media safe zones, and much more.

records.name: UCP Radar
records.tagline: Make your product feed visible to AI shopping agents
records.description: Your titles and descriptions were probably never written to Google's spec. And the fields AI agents read (material, product details, age group, highlights, FAQ) are sitting empty. Connecting UCP Radar to Merchant Center is one click. It then works through the catalog, flagging what breaks GMC rules and what hides you from AI shopping assistants, rewriting weak titles and filling the blanks. Brand names it leaves alone. Out comes a supplemental feed Google, Perplexity and ChatGPT can read.

records.name: calcdaystime.com
records.tagline: Dates, time, and math calculators — free, no signup
records.description: CalcDaysTime is a free collection of date, time, and math calculators — no sign-up, no ad clutter. Get instant countdowns (Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, custom dates), time duration & time card calculators, plus percentage, tip, and ratio tools. Built to answer everyday questions fast, on any device. New calculators added regularly. Feedback welcome!

records.name: imyme
records.tagline: Turn your resume into a live portfolio site in 2 minutes
records.description: Turn your resume into a professional portfolio in minutes with AI, or customize it using a powerful drag-and-drop builder. Publish instantly with a free subdomain, custom domain support, and built-in analytics.

records.name: Akintu
records.tagline: Your best salesperson, available 24/7.
records.description: Turn website traffic into qualified leads, bookings and sales. Akintu answers questions, handles objections and moves every visitor toward the right next step.

records.name: SerpRankings
records.tagline: See which brands ChatGPT recommends for Free
records.description: A free AI Visibility Index that shows which brands rank in ChatGPT. Browse categories, explore top brands, and see how AI search is reshaping online visibility.

records.name: Salestrics MCP
records.tagline: Your Agents. Your Business. Connected.
records.description: Without live CRM, inbox, and financial context, AI agents operate completely blind. Salestrics MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects tools like Cursor, Claude Desktop, and VS Code directly to your live workspace. Empower your agents to query pipeline data, update deal stages, trigger automations, and sync across tools like Stripe and Slack—all through one secure, org-scoped connection. Stop tab-switching and copying context. Connect your agents today at salestrics.com.
